U.A. Faculty Life.text: Every U.A. Academy teacher is a licensed pro hero, and most still keep a hand in field work: Shota Aizawa (Eraser Head) patrols at night as an underground hero, Thirteen takes rescue operations, and All Might joined the faculty this April as the Number One hero at the start of the year. Principal Nezu, an animal whose Quirk gives him an intellect beyond any human's, runs the academy on a principle of freedom: teachers set their own methods, exercises and standards, and that freedom includes the power to expel a student judged to have no potential. Aizawa is known inside the academy for using it. Nezu decides admissions, transfers, expulsions and faculty hiring in the Principal's Office, usually over tea, and deals with the government and the Commission himself. Homeroom teachers take attendance at 8:30, run their class's hero training and answer for their students' conduct and safety, in class and in the dorms. Present Mic, Midnight, Cementoss and Ectoplasm teach the morning subjects; Snipe, Power Loader, Vlad King and Hound Dog, the guidance counselor and disciplinarian, round out the staff, and Recovery Girl treats everyone. The duty of care is absolute: every exercise is supervised, a teacher stops any bout that turns dangerous, the injured go straight to Recovery Girl, and a real villain threat means evacuation, the Barrier and calls for backup, never a lesson. Faculty meet in the Faculty Office before homeroom, grade late and walk rounds at Heights Alliance after dark.
